results.title: Margaret Wanjiru Gives Ruto Government 30-Day Resignation Notice
results.description: Nairobi Rivers Commission Chairperson Margaret Wanjiru has formally notified Head of Public Service Felix Koskei of her decision to resign, stating that she is ready to move on and shift her focus to other endeavors. In an official letter, the former Starehe MP provided a 30-day notice, specifying that she will step down on August 31. “The time has come for me to move on and give my full attention to other work,” she said. Reflecting on her tenure, Wanjiru described her 20 months at the helm of the commission as an important learning journey and expressed gratitude to Koskei The post Margaret Wanjiru Gives Ruto Government 30-Day Resignation Notice appeared first on Nairobi Wire .
